The plate holds a small portion of what looks like toasted pearl (Israeli) couscous with some greens and possibly a bit of tofu or cheese. The portion is about 1/2 cup cooked, roughly 90 g. Cooked couscous is around 1.7 kcal/g, and the oil used for toasting adds a little more, so I estimate about 160 kcal.
